elements.name: Vega
elements.features: Lean, average-height build; hair, facial hair, and eyes obscured, preventing further distinguishing details.

voice.instructions: Speak at a brisk but unhurried pace with warm confidence, light neutral American accent colouring, and an adult voice suggesting early 30s.
voice.why: A bright, warm voice gives Vega an approachable, energetic presence.
voice.sample_text: My name is Vega. Over Meridian Range, Vega’s F-35C and Rook’s F-35C race above blue ocean, gray wings spread, twin tails canted outward.

elements.name: Rook
elements.features: Average build; hair, facial hair, and eyes obscured by headgear.

voice.instructions: Speak at a measured pace with dry understatement, subtle British accent colouring, and a mature adult voice suggesting mid-40s.
voice.why: A low, restrained voice gives Rook a grounded presence that contrasts with Vega.
voice.sample_text: My name is Rook. Over Meridian Range, Vega’s F-35C and Rook’s F-35C race above blue ocean, gray wings spread, twin tails canted outward.

voice.instructions: Use a mature, low register with a calm documentary tone, measured pacing, clear articulation, unhurried pauses, and neutral accent colouring.
voice.descriptor: a calm documentary narrator for this film: measured, clear, unhurried
voice.why: Ash’s low, dry, measured delivery suits a calm documentary narrator.
voice.sample_text: Together, On Target. A short film from the record.

fixtures.detail: An isolated, weathered offshore platform raised above the sea on dark legs and cross-braced supports, with projecting decks, railings, a boxlike upper cabin, an overhanging roof and a narrow upright mast.
fixtures.name: Offshore platform

meridian-range.light: Natural daylight filtered through extensive blue-grey clouds; brighter pale light breaks through on the right, softly illuminating the sea and silhouetting much of the platform.
meridian-range.floor: No visible floor or land; rippling deep-blue seawater fills the foreground and middle distance, extending to a flat horizon.
meridian-range.walls: No enclosing walls; open sea and a broad, cloud-filled blue sky.

fixtures.detail: A dark angular instrument console with a large central display, smaller flanking displays, rows of square bezel buttons, and lower switches and knobs.
fixtures.name: Instrument panel

fixtures.detail: A small tilted rectangular screen mounted below the main instrument displays.
fixtures.name: Lower display

fixtures.detail: A black upright control grip with a rounded head, buttons and a red control, beside the instrument panel.
fixtures.name: Control stick

fixtures.detail: A tall black padded seat with a broad headrest, projecting side supports, dark harness straps and exposed rigid framing.
fixtures.name: Pilot seat

fixtures.detail: A curved dark metal canopy arch rising around the front instrument area.
fixtures.name: Canopy frame

fixtures.detail: A broad clear curved canopy showing blue sky and clouds, with faint reflections across its surface.
fixtures.name: Transparent canopy

fixtures.detail: A low black interior side panel and horizontal rail running between the instrument console and seat.
fixtures.name: Cockpit sidewall panel

fixtures.detail: A wide blue-grey metal cockpit rim with panel seams and a dark upper lip, crossing the bottom of the picture.
fixtures.name: Cockpit sill

vega-cockpit.light: Strong natural daylight enters through the clear canopy, giving the sky and glazing a cool blue cast and catching the metal edges; the seat and lower cockpit remain in deep shadow. Instrument screens have dim blue-toned surfaces.
vega-cockpit.floor: The cockpit floor is obscured by the sill, instrument console and seat.
vega-cockpit.walls: No conventional walls; the enclosure consists of a clear curved canopy above dark charcoal and blue-grey metal cockpit panels and framing.

fixtures.detail: A large sloping grey instrument housing with a broad dark reflective display and a black lower recess.
fixtures.name: Foreground instrument console

fixtures.detail: A tall black padded seat back and headrest with vertical seams, metal side supports and visible harness straps below.
fixtures.name: Pilot seat

fixtures.detail: A curved dark instrument panel, partly hidden by the seat, with round dial gauges, dark rectangular displays, switches and yellow-and-black striped markings.
fixtures.name: Forward instrument panel

fixtures.detail: A dark metal side console with inset panels, small instruction placards and a narrow bank of controls.
fixtures.name: Left cockpit console

fixtures.detail: A partially visible sloping black control panel with small knobs, switches and a yellow-edged lever assembly.
fixtures.name: Left lower control bank

fixtures.detail: A dark angular side console with panel seams, exposed fasteners and a small rectangular instruction placard.
fixtures.name: Right cockpit console

fixtures.detail: A short upright black grip with a rounded top, beside the large central instrument housing.
fixtures.name: Control grip

fixtures.detail: A heavy black curved canopy frame with visible fasteners, extending up the left edge and overhead.
fixtures.name: Left canopy frame

fixtures.detail: A heavy black curved canopy frame descending along the right edge.
fixtures.name: Right canopy frame

fixtures.detail: Clear curved glazing supported by a slender metal arch above the seat, with sloping glazed sections on both sides.
fixtures.name: Forward canopy glazing and arch

rook-cockpit.light: Strong warm natural daylight enters through the clear canopy, brightest from the right. It produces golden highlights on metal edges and upholstery, reflections across the foreground display, and deep shadows within the cockpit. No illuminated interior light source is visible.
rook-cockpit.floor: The cockpit floor is obscured by the seat, instrument housing and side consoles.
rook-cockpit.walls: No conventional walls: the enclosure consists of clear curved canopy glazing above dark charcoal and grey-green painted metal side panels, with rivets, screws, seams and small instruction placards.
